$comment: Per-size parameter sets for the Circular view SVG generator. Adding a size means adding an entry under 'sizes', not editing generator code. Values come from the geometry spec's invariants, tuned by eye where the spec declines to derive (face-ellipse offset and semi-axes, apex rounding). See README.md for derivation notes.

3.$comment: Extracted from the committed reference asset src/views/circular/view.svg. Regenerating from these values must reproduce it.

2.$comment: Shares the 3x3 triangle and ring step, so r_max = r_min + (N-1)*ringStep = 85 rather than 100. viewBox is sized to the actual geometry extent, including the face ellipses, with margin so nothing clips.

4.$comment: Uses the shared ring step. Minimum sticker clearance turns out to be independent of the ring count (it tracks ringStep, not N), so four rings need no larger step than three — an earlier assumption to the contrary was measured and dropped. Only the viewBox grows, to fit r_max = r_min + 3*ringStep = 115.

5.$comment: Validation-only size for the ghost rule. Never committed.
